label: Roster records
denominator: Established topical roster of 21073 distinct record identifiers
reconciliation: Retain every scope disposition or processing exception; accuracy uses separate reference-sample denominators

label: In-scope dissertations and theses
denominator: In-scope works; content percentages state completed applicable base
reconciliation: Reconcile duplicate identifiers; report uncertain inapplicable incomplete and unassigned-field cases separately

label: ProQuest-listed dissertations and theses
denominator: All-topic works and in-scope subset in identical ownership-resolved analysis-unit year degree-level cells, including approved combined units
reconciliation: Use same retained-work mapping; report comparison exclusions; in-scope count cannot exceed all-topic count

label: Degrees awarded
denominator: Matched institution survey-year award-level all-fields totals
reconciliation: Count each total once; use first-major all-fields rows; keep unavailable and unmatched totals separate

label: Authors represented by in-scope works
denominator: People represented under the specified identity and index-completion rules
reconciliation: Account for repeated works and uncertain matches; report person total separately; do not infer a complete graduating cohort

label: People selected for employment follow-up
denominator: Selected observed or scored people as specified for each result
reconciliation: Reconcile the three subsets and missing information against the stated base
